newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Silicon Graphics raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Silicon Graphics raised.

text.p: Bear Stearns raised its rating for Silicon Graphics Inc Friday to attractive from neutral, a source at the brokerage said.
-- Shares in the maker of computer workstations opened up 6-2/16 at 25-9/16.
-- Raised fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $1.55 per share from $1.10. Fiscal 1999 estimate is $1.90 per share.
-- Target price is $30-35 per share, based on 18-20 times earnings.

-- In research note, Analyst John Jones said Silicon Graphics's fourth quarter earnings of $0.56 per share, "decimated our $0.30 estimate for the quarter as well as the street's consensus estimate of $0.34."
